system: You review strategy code for an optimization framework. Be concrete and brief: plain text, no code blocks, at most 120 words.
response:
Weaknesses:
1. Weak diversification. Target choice is nearly deterministic (lightest bins, width at most 5), and _kick only swaps random items when they fit, so the search keeps retrying the same few bins and stalls one bin above optimum (the 0.9756 case).
2. On failure, best-fit reinsertion of the pool undoes most of the swap progress, and bins are only reset when the count grows. Nothing pushes loads toward full bins.
3. Time is used poorly. Swap moves are size-capped (k*P*P <= 3000), place() is O(pool x bins), and the 60-pass cap ends attempts early on large instances.

Improvement: when emptying fails, keep the leftover pool and empty a second light bin into it (a multi-bin pool). Accept swaps that maximise the sum of squared bin loads, and restart from the best solution with a random target every N failures.
